questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Ethiopia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Ethiopia article.

questions.proof: His death in 1889 resulted in the power base shifting back to the dominant Amharic-speaking elite prior to Yejju Oromo and Tigrayan rule.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Ethiopians constitute several component ethnic groups, many of which are closely related to ethnic groups in neighboring _____ and other parts of the Horn of Africa.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “neighboring”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Ethiopians” part of the Ethiopia article.

questions.proof: Ethiopians constitute several component ethnic groups, many of which are closely related to ethnic groups in neighboring Eritrea and other parts of the Horn of Africa.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It lost its Red Sea ports when Eritrea gained independence in _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ethiopia article.

questions.proof: It lost its Red Sea ports when Eritrea gained independence in 1993.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It avoided being colonized until _____, when it was invaded by the Italians under Benito Mussolini, who took over the country for a brief time.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ethiopia article.

questions.proof: It avoided being colonized until 1935, when it was invaded by the Italians under Benito Mussolini, who took over the country for a brief time.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It also saw the dispatching of embassies to Louis XIV's _____ and to Dutch India.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “XIV's”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Ethiopia article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: It also saw the dispatching of embassies to Louis XIV's France and to Dutch India.
